// Oracle for tsrs: decodes inputs exactly as the pinned server does and prints the outcome.
package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/api/requestfilesystem"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/json"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/jsonrpc"
)

type inCase struct {
	Kind  string `json:"kind"`
	Input string `json:"input"`
}

type outCase struct {
	Kind   string     `json:"kind"`
	Input  string     `json:"input"`
	Error  string     `json:"error"`
	Value  json.Value `json:"value,omitempty"`
	HexStr string     `json:"hex,omitempty"`
}

// callbackfs.go callbackResponse + decodeCallbackResponse + the readFile "value" branch.
type callbackResponse struct {
	Kind  string     `json:"kind"`
	Value json.Value `json:"value"`
}

func main() {
	data, _ := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
	var cases []inCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var out []outCase
	for _, c := range cases {
		o := outCase{Kind: c.Kind, Input: c.Input}
		raw, err := hex.DecodeString(c.Input)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		c.Input = string(raw)
		switch c.Kind {
		case "requestfs":
			var fs *requestfilesystem.RequestFileSystem
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Input), &fs); err != nil {
				o.Error = err.Error()
			} else {
				v, _ := json.Marshal(fs)
				o.Value = v
			}
		case "jsonrpc":
			var m jsonrpc.Message
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Input), &m); err != nil {
				o.Error = err.Error()
			} else {
				o.Value = json.Value(`"ok"`)
			}
		case "readFile":
			var r callbackResponse
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Input), &r); err != nil {
				o.Error = "response: " + err.Error()
			} else {
				var s string
				if err := json.Unmarshal(r.Value, &s); err != nil {
					o.Error = "value: " + err.Error()
				} else {
					o.HexStr = hex.EncodeToString([]byte(s))
				}
			}
		}
		out = append(out, o)
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	os.Stdout.Write(b)
}
